free_tier.stated: no free custom-domain mailbox: the Free plan has 1 GB of storage and no custom domains; Revolutionary at €3 per month paid yearly adds 20 GB, 15 extra addresses and 3 custom domains
free_tier.notes: Legend is €8 per month paid yearly with 500 GB, 30 extra addresses and 10 custom domains. Prices include taxes. Free accounts are deleted after more than six months without a login. unverified: no sending cap is published on the captured pages.

retention.stated: 20 GB on Revolutionary; a Free account is deleted after more than six months without a login

egress.terms: not applicable: a mailbox with no IMAP, POP or SMTP access from Tuta; mail is read and sent through the Tuta web, desktop and mobile apps, or through an unofficial bridge to Tuta's native API

interface_detail: Tuta's own web, desktop and mobile apps; Tuta offers no IMAP, POP or SMTP, which it states it cannot offer with end-to-end encryption
tooling: Tuta's own web, desktop and mobile apps, open source under GPLv3 with Tuta's Rust SDK in the same repository; Tuta offers no IMAP, POP or SMTP. Unofficial open-source bridges serve IMAP and SMTP over Tuta's API: TutaBridge (Rust; a desktop app or a CLI binary) and tuta-proxy (Python or Docker; also CalDAV, CardDAV and WebDAV); the user installs and runs the bridge beside the mail client or script that uses it.
chaining: an end-to-end encrypted mailbox for up to 3 custom domains at €3 per month paid yearly (Revolutionary), or 10 at €8 per month (Legend), read and sent through Tuta's own web, desktop and mobile apps, or by a script or mail client through an unofficial IMAP and SMTP bridge to Tuta's API that the user installs and runs.

limits.value: no IMAP, POP or SMTP access from Tuta: its own apps are the supported clients, and unofficial bridges reach the mail through Tuta's native API
custom domains need a paid plan: 3 on Revolutionary, 10 on Legend, none on Free
20 GB of storage on Revolutionary, 1 GB on Free

limits_note: no vocabulary kind names a removed mail protocol; it is filed as retention-clamped, as in the Zoho Mail record, and the true kind is a protocol gate
binding_note: a custom domain needs a paid plan: the Free plan has none, Revolutionary at €3 per month paid yearly has 3 and Legend at €8 per month paid yearly has 10, so a custom-domain mailbox starts at the Revolutionary price.

identity_cost.detail: signup asks for no phone number, and an account may be held for approval for up to 48 hours, which choosing a paid plan skips. Custom domains need a paid plan, paid by credit card, PayPal, or a gift card bought with Monero, Bitcoin or cash through a partner. unverified: whether signup asks for an existing email address

reliability_note: a Free account is deleted after more than six months without a login; a new signup may be held for approval for up to 48 hours
confidence_note: plans and prices read from the rendered pricing page; protocol support read from vendor blog posts; no account was made
